question: Which local predecessor conditions bound the thirteen remaining direct Wonder-predicate arguments, and what selected arithmetic feeds the additional Stonehenge AI modifier?

scope.boundary: Local predecessor paths and selected AI input arithmetic are supported. Complete function reachability, indirect/non-call dispatch, computed or aliased claim-slot consumers, the complete AI valuation, and runtime behavior are outside this result.

dependencies.use: Supplies thirteen exact frontiers, 45 local literals, and the second index-three consumer.
Supplies the accepted 64 direct-call sites and six city-update literal sequences.
Binds the distinct Temple-conditioned city contribution and ownership limits.
Identifies AIUnitChoiceEvaluate without assigning the entire retained value a semantic score.

predecessorArguments.zeroReturnJoin: Each listed path calls 0x82CEF6A8, compares returned r3 with zero, and branches away when nonzero. Its continuing path writes only r4 and r5 before calling 0x82CEF4E8, leaving r3 equal to zero. This is a conditional local argument proof; the callee body is not expanded.

otherSites.join: 0x82CD4A14 compares r3 with one; 0x82CD4A18 branches away when unequal. Only r5 and r4 are written before the predicate call.
0x82CEFCD4 loads r3 with 19; 0x82CEFCD8 can branch out. The continuing path writes only r5 before the predicate call.

predecessorArguments.inventoryJoin: The 51 accepted local literal sequences plus these thirteen predecessor joins bound arguments at all 64 inventoried raw direct call sites. Two local sequences select index three: the city Temple call at 0x82D14F88 and AI call at 0x82CB59D0. The other thirteen newly selected paths use zero, one, or nineteen.
predecessorArguments.qualification: This does not establish execution, all possible incoming control flow, non-call branches, function-pointer calls, direct/computed slot readers, or sole-effect status.

aiInputs.cityJoin: 0x82CB44FC saves incoming city index at stack +0x234. 0x82CB4500 multiplies that index by 0xBC; 0x82CB4504 forms city table base 0x8314FE28. 0x82CB4520 and 0x82CB4570 retain its signed owner byte in r20. The later selected call passes r20 in r4 and the saved incoming city in r5.
aiInputs.localBase: On the 0x82CB592C path, signed city byte +0x03 is multiplied by 30 at 0x82CB5950. A word indexed by signed city-owner byte through current r23 is loaded at 0x82CB5954, incremented by two, and used by signed divw at 0x82CB5964 to produce r31. Native division trap checks remain in the selected sequence.
aiInputs.localModifiers: 0x82CB5974..0x82CB59C0 conditionally doubles r31 for a word-three comparison and city halfword +0x3C bit 0x10, adds 100 for city word +0x24 bit 0x10000, and clears r31 for another indexed word-three comparison. 0x82CB59D0 then conditionally adds signed half of r31 with truncation toward zero, as accepted in stonehenge-caller-argument-coverage.
aiInputs.downstream: 0x82CB59F4 calls the accepted civilization-bonus predicate 0x82CF0CB0 with effect index four; its nonzero return causes another retained half-addition. 0x82CB5A14..0x82CB5A1C subsequently replaces a negative r31 with zero. Complete later valuation and selection are not read.
aiInputs.setupBoundary: The selected 0x82CB48F8 branch can bypass the inspected table-setup sequence at 0x82CB48FC..0x82CB4A1C. Current r23/r25 and stack +0x60 therefore are not assigned unconditional table identities from that sequence. Their complete route-specific provenance remains open.
aiInputs.qualification: The selected native arithmetic and owner/city call arguments are supported. No whole AI score, candidate-item interpretation, decision, balance consequence, or runtime valuation is assigned.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only DumpMemoryWords selected thirteen radius-64 frontier windows plus two radius-64 AI windows; the paired Calendar window was checked separately. Four radius-24 AI joins corroborated entry and route-specific setup. Every emitted word matched the supported flat image. Exact generated instruction metadata and narrow windows corroborated local branch, argument, and arithmetic sequences.
currentEvidence.qualification: The existing direct-call inventory was reused; no unchanged caller or exact-slot scan was repeated. Generated address-map gaps outside the promoted sequences were not assigned instruction semantics. No complete function, callee, computed-slot search, or runtime observation was added.

guards: Do not identify the additional AI modifier as the final city Culture output or suppress ordinary ownership.

Do not assign unconditional AI table identities or remove its other native modifiers from one route-specific setup.
Do not interpret static local arithmetic as runtime mod activation or acceptance.
conclusion: The thirteen selected predecessors add no index-three call to the accepted direct inventory. Two local direct-call sequences select Stonehenge: Temple yield and an AI retained-value modifier. Selected AI arithmetic and owner/city arguments are bounded, while complete valuation, computed or aliased slot consumers, and runtime replacement remain unresolved.
